dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.organic: Got you. Hold still; this won't take long.
This will sting. Hold still and I will be gentle.
Caught you. That form won't stop the bite.
Don't struggle. The bite is already changing you.
Stay down. One light scratch is enough.
The claw touched. Hold on; the change has started.
Don't dodge. The claw already made contact.
Fast reaction, but one scratch was enough.
I've got you. Match my breathing and don't twist yourself.
Stop struggling. I am not trying to hurt you. I will let go when it passes.
Pinned. You're much stronger than a human.
Don't counter yet. Let's see how long that form holds.
There. Stand up slowly. Your body will find its balance.
Second assimilation complete. Stand and try a few steps.
I know you have a partner. I changed the body, not your bond.
There. Go back now. Your partner is waiting.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_drow: Out of air? Hold on to me. I am wrapping you now!
Save your breath. Rest inside until it comes back.
There it is. Stay inside a little longer.
I caught you this time. Call me before the air runs out again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_drown: You are out of air. Come here, now!
Stop sinking. Get inside and catch your breath.
Breathing restored. Good. Stay put a little longer.
Made it in time. Signal earlier next time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_dr: Grab on! I will pull you to the surface.
Do not fight me. Follow my movement upward.
You are steady. Wait before diving again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_dr: You are out of air! Come here, I have you.
No deeper. Get inside and breathe.
You are back. Swim slower for a while.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_drow: Partner! You are almost out of air! Get right here before you drown!
Got you. Stay inside, so you won't drown that quick.
Can you breath, buddy? Ooof... You almost drown there. Don't be so reckless next time!
That was really close. Don't try anything this dumb again, yes?
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.disguise_d: Haven't seen you before. Which patrol? ...Never mind. Fall in.
New mask? Looks sharp. Stay on this side and keep up.
You must be new. Good, we had room for one more.
Hold still. Let me look... All right, move along.
Something's odd. Hm. Maybe I'm imagining it.
Hey, why do you look a little strange...?
Stop! You're not one of us!
I knew it—you gave yourself away!
Nearly let you through. Don't move.
So this was an ambush. Cut them off!
You slipped into our line just to swing at us? Get them.
Cap off, act over. Stay where you are.
Done dressing up? Then start running.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.disguise_: Black mask. Spread out and keep them back.
Dark latex. Fine, let's chase this one out.
A dark latex dares come this close...? Surround them!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_disgui: Patting your own squad? Fine. One.
That's an odd greeting. Are all the new ones like this?
I was sure something felt off... Forget it. You're good at this.
All right, now we've met properly. One more is fine.
You thought a pat would sell the act? Not a chance.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_disgu: Dressed like dark latex and you still reach for me? Hands off.
Don't act friendly. That disguise already has me on edge.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_player: Hey, come over and say hello.
New one, don't dodge. We greet our own around here.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.spotted_h: A human came in... a real one. Everyone, stop crowding this way.
A real human hasn't walked in here for years. Easy. You've woken the whole place.
Everyone noticed the moment you arrived. Don't be afraid; it's simply been too long.
A human out here? Wait, I cannot be imagining this.
Where did you come from? Don't go yet. They'll question me all night.
I'm the only one who saw you... may I speak to you first?
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.spotted_t: An outsider came in. Don't crowd them. If they're friendly, so are we.
A new face on our ground. Let's say hello without scaring them away.
Never seen that form before. That's all right. If you mean no harm, there's room for you here.
An outsider out here? Relax, I only wanted to say hello.
It's only me here. If you're friendly, we'll get along.
I don't know that form, but you seem friendly. Want some company?
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_spec: Same species. Don't wait at the door; come in.
No wonder you felt familiar. This place is yours too.
One of my own species, out here? Let's travel together.
You're exactly my kind. Everyone back home will want to meet you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_cate: Kin, though not my species. That's fine. There's room for you here.
Different species, but I can still tell you're kin. Come rest with us.
Finding kin out here beats walking alone. Coming with me?
Not my species, but still one of us. Stay close.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_frie: A friend. Come in; no one here will bother you.
You're not kin, but you're welcome with us.
Friendly company? Good. Let's walk together for a while.
Someone peaceful out here. That's a nice surprise.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_riva: Stop there. This is our home, and you're not going farther in.
It's the other side. Everyone, spread out and block the way.
We don't want a fight at home. Back off while you can.
Of all the creatures to meet out here. Are we parting ways, or settling this?
You're with the other side. This isn't anyone's home, so don't make us chase you.
I'm not wasting the whole trip fighting you. Keep your distance.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.meet_outs: You're not kin, but that's all right. Keep it friendly and we'll get along.
This is our home. If you mean no harm, we won't trouble you.
A face we don't know. Relax. We can start on friendly terms.
Haven't seen you before. We're both out here, so let's keep it friendly.
You're not kin, but that's fine. I don't mean you any harm either.
New face. Want to part ways, or walk together for a bit?
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.spotted_hu: A human entered our ground... everyone steady. Don't jam the same exit.
A real human. Hold the edges; I'm approaching. Nobody goes first.
Years of waiting, and one walks straight into the middle. Bold. I like that.
Human outside. Stay quiet; I want one more look.
You picked quite a place to appear. Keep up; don't lose this news.
Not a mirage. Human. This trip was worth it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.spotted_tr: An outsider on our ground. Hold steady. If they don't swing, neither do we.
Don't know that form. Remember the rule: no trouble, no fight.
New face. We watch this ground. Keep it friendly and there won't be a problem.
Outsider ahead. Don't swing first. There's no need to make trouble.
New face. This isn't anyone's ground. Keep it friendly and we're fine.
Met you on the road. Move on or talk, either is fine. Just don't start trouble.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_speci: Same species. Over here, we could use a hand.
I knew you at a glance. Come in. Our own don't take the long way.
Same species, out here of all places. Good, you can watch my back.
Same species. Keep up. Now the squad feels complete.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_categ: You're kin. Different species, sure, but we still saved you a place.
You move like one of us, even if you're a different species. Come in.
Kin after all. Walk beside me; the road will be easier.
Not my species, still one of us. Want to team up?
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_frien: Friends can enter. Stay close and don't wander into trouble.
Not kin, but we can work together. Another pair of eyes helps.
You seem friendly. Good. We watch out for each other on the road.
Not one of us, but we get along. Keep up.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_rival: The other side is inside our territory. Hold the inner route; the rest, with me.
Our ground. Take another step and we all move.
Starting trouble at our door? Fine. We brought numbers.
Ran into the other side on the road... Hold steady. Don't let them come any closer!
This place is neither yours nor ours. If we're fighting, let's get on with it.
Of course it's you. Keep the line together and push.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.meet_outsi: An outsider. This is our ground. Don't cause trouble and there won't be any.
You're not kin, but keep it friendly and we won't trouble you.
You can stay. Follow our rules and there won't be a problem.
A stranger out here. Relax, we're not looking for trouble.
Not kin, not a rival either. Keep it friendly and we're fine.
The road's wide enough. You go your way and we'll go ours.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cur: Where are you going? I want to see.
Keep moving. I want to see how you try to lose me.
You were just here. Let me think.
Nothing that way. I'll try another route.
I haven't met anyone like you. Let me get a better look.
Wait. You've caught my interest.
You again. I never finished asking my questions.
I remember you. Where have you been this time?
Again, please. I haven't worked out what that feels like.
So that's how you greet someone.
Don't dodge. I only want to see how you react.
Hm. That wasn't the reaction I expected.
Wait, why did you hit me?
Was that an accident, or are you starting something?
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cau: Slow down. Keep your hands where I can see them.
I won't rush in, so don't try anything clever.
The trail stops here. I'll check nearby...
It's too quiet. You may be waiting for me.
Stay there. Let me get a clear look before you come closer.
Don't come closer so quickly. Let me get used to you.
It's you. At least I know who's coming this time.
I remember you. You can come closer, slowly.
Gentle. I'm not completely used to this yet.
You can continue, but don't press without warning.
Don't tense up. I'll only touch you once.
Step away if you dislike it. I won't keep reaching for you.
Back away. I have to watch you now.
Do that again and I won't call it an accident.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pro: Stop there. Don't bring trouble near the others.
If you want past me, you'll have to try harder.
I won't leave the others behind just to chase you.
You had better be keeping away from them.
Move gently. Don't startle the ones behind me.
Behave yourself and I won't give you trouble.
It's you. Stay close, the others know you now.
Good, you're back. You're safe here.
All right, I'm here. Tell me if anything comes close.
Don't worry about the noise. I'm watching the area.
Hold still. Let me see whether you are hurt.
There, you're fine. Stay close.
Don't force me to fight beside my companions.
Come at me if you must, but leave them out of it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.sho: Watch closely. I know more than one way to catch you.
Run faster. Don't let me catch you as soon as I start.
Enjoy your head start. I'll find you soon enough.
A decent hiding place won't change the ending.
Good timing. I could use an audience.
Have another look. I am looking sharp today.
You came back to see me? Good choice.
Perfect timing. I just learned something new.
Careful, you'll spoil the pose I worked on.
You finally noticed me. About time.
See? I'm good at this too.
Don't pull away. My technique is better than you think.
Was that all? I expected something more impressive.
You didn't need to hit that hard to get my attention.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cal: Take your time. I'm in no hurry.
There's no need to panic. I'll catch up.
It's fine. Something will move if I wait.
I'll stop and listen. Rushing would only scare them off.
If you mean no harm, you can stay here.
You needn't be nervous. We can keep to ourselves.
I remember you. Come and rest for a while.
There you are. You look more relaxed than last time.
Mm, that's pleasant just as it is.
You don't have to stop. I don't mind.
Relax. I'm only saying hello.
Don't brace yourself. I won't press hard.
Stop. This doesn't have to become a fight.
Put that down while I'm still willing to wait.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.com: Come on, let's see which of us slows down first.
Don't hold back. I dislike an easy win.
This round isn't over just because I lost sight of you.
You're ahead for now. The next move may change that.
You look capable. We should test that sometime.
You move quickly. I wonder how quick you really are.
Another round? I still remember the last one.
Good timing. I've wanted another try.
Not bad. Now let me show you mine.
That one earns you half a point.
Your turn. See if you can do better.
Don't dodge. I'm setting the standard.
If you want a contest, don't begin with a cheap shot.
Hit me again and I'll answer. Don't complain afterward.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pla: Run. I was looking for an excuse to stretch my legs.
Don't run straight. Make the chase interesting.
Good hiding place. You almost fooled me.
Make some noise. This chase has gone far too quiet.
You don't look boring. That's promising.
Since you're here, come wander with me.
There you are. I could use some company.
We meet again. Don't leave so quickly this time.
That was a good one. I wouldn't object to another.
You found the right spot. Nicely done.
Don't look so serious. It's only a little pat.
There, I caught you off guard.
Hey, that stopped being fun.
Easy. I never agreed to a fight.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.sen: Don't turn suddenly. I can hear every step.
Slow down. You're making more noise than you realize.
This silence feels wrong. You're still nearby.
Something moved over there. I heard it.
Wait a moment. I'm not used to unfamiliar movement.
Your footsteps are louder than you think.
I know those footsteps. Good, it's you.
I remember you. You don't startle me now.
Gentle. I can feel even a light touch.
Go slowly and don't pull your hand away at once.
You seemed tense. Is that any better?
I'll only touch you once. I don't want to startle you.
That hurt more than you seem to realize.
Don't strike without warning. I remember things like that.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cur: So the touch was only meant to make me relax. I understand now.
I thought you wanted to stop. I read that wrong.
Again? No. I already tried trusting that once.
I do not need to test that twice. Move your hand.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cau: I should not have dropped my guard so quickly. Stay back.
I knew something was wrong. You will not get a second chance.
Keep your hand away. I do not make the same mistake twice.
Stop there. I trusted you once. That was enough.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pro: You used a peaceful touch to get a free hit. Stay away from my companions.
Come at me if you must. Do not use that trick to reach the others.
Stay away from them. Reaching out only puts us on guard now.
I will not gamble with my companions' safety again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.sho: That trick caught me once. Once.
Fine, you got your hit. It will not be that easy next time.
The same trick twice? Save it.
I was not ready last time. I am now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cal: I agreed to stop. You were the one who ruined it.
I was ready to let the chase go. That has changed.
One touch will not make me forget what happened. Step back.
There is no need to pat me. I no longer trust what you mean by it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.com: If you want a contest, start it properly. Why pretend to stop?
You stole the first move. I will not hold back now.
Face me if you want to continue. Do not use that as a pause.
No break this time. Move your hand.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pla: I thought that meant we were making up. This is not fun anymore.
You hid a hit behind a pat? Now I am angry.
No. You already spoiled that game once.
Do not act sweet. I remember what followed last time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.sen: You let me relax, then hit me. Do not touch me again.
I remember. You touched me, then the next thing I felt was your fist.
Do not touch me. Now I flinch when you reach out.
Move your hand. I remember how much it hurt after I relaxed.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.polite_no: Don't crowd them! A real human... let me go alone before we scare them off.
Everyone settle down. I know it's been years. Let me say hello first.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.polite_pr: May I touch you? I still cannot believe you are really here.
Easy. Answer me once, and I won't let the others crowd in.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.polite_re: You answered... good. Everyone will remember you.
So we really can greet each other. Next time, I'll call your name first.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.polite_no: That's all right. I'll step back. Everyone got excited at once.
You still don't trust us. Fair. I'll move the others back.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_playe: There you are again. I can still greet you this way, right?
I remember you. Come here, just like last time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.polite_not: Nobody move. That's a real human... let me go first, and don't scare them off.
Hold the line. I know everyone's looking. The first word is mine.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.polite_pro: Give me your hand. I need to see whether you are somebody's old story.
Don't dodge. It's a greeting. I promise nothing will happen today.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.polite_res: Good. You answered. Next time, I'll hold the others back.
Remember me. Next time, we won't have to begin with a chase.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.polite_no_: You don't have to. I'll step back, and the others will behave.
Still don't trust us? Fair. I'll have the group spread out.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_player: It is you. Our last understanding still stands. Come here.
Let me touch you. Relax, I recognize you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.polite_: Stay back. That scent... human. Let me approach slowly.
They haven't run! Don't crowd them; I want to hear them speak first.
May I touch you? I want to remember your warmth and scent.
Don't force yourself. I'll come closer only if you answer.
That response is real... good. I'll remember you.
You answered. Next time, I won't watch from so far away.
Then I won't. I'll step back, and I won't chase.
You're still wary. Fair. Get used to my scent first.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_pla: I remember that you answer. May I touch you again?
That response is familiar. Good, you can relax.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.polite_: Wait, a human! Stop splashing. I want to approach on my own.
They're still here. Quiet. Let me come through the shallows first.
May I touch you? Lightly. I won't pull you into the water.
Just hold your hand near the surface. I'll come closer if you want.
You really answered. Next time, I'll call to you from the water.
Good. I'll remember you. There'll be room for you by the water.
That's all right. I'll go back to the shallows while you watch.
Still afraid of me? All right, I'll back away.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_pla: No need for another test. Come say hello.
I know you. Relax, I will not suddenly pull you away.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.polite_no: Wait, that's a real human! Guys, stop! Let me greet it.
Don't chase it yet. We don't know if it is hostile. Let me say hello first.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.polite_pr: Hello. Can I touch you? Just one simple touch.
Wait, please. let me remember what you look like.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.polite_re: Ah, so you answered back! I welcome you then! Hope we can be friends!
I see, you are not hostile. I'll make sure to tell the resto so they wont attack you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.polite_no: No answer? Fine, I suppose. I won't chase, just be careful out thre.
Uh, I guess you still afraid of me. Okay, I understand. I'll be gentler next time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_playe: I know who you are. Don't worry, it's just a pat.
No need to dodge this time. I'm only greeting you, not transfurring you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pol: I asked you to stop. Now I have to chase you.
Stop now and we can still talk.
Don't make me search every corner. Come out.
I'm still waiting for an answer. Stop hiding.
I'll stay here. Come closer if you want to.
Let's say hello before either of us gets startled.
I remember you. It is safe to come closer.
We meet again. There is no need for another test.
Thank you. Mm, that was gentle.
That's good. We can relax.
Stay a moment. I'll only touch you once.
I will be gentle. You do not need to move away.
I came to say hello. Why did you hit me?
Stop. If that was a mistake, you can still show it.
You accepted my greeting, then turned around and hit me. I'll remember that.
If you want a fight, say so. Do not hide it behind kindness.
No. I will not mistake your hand for kindness again.
Please step back. Last time was clear enough.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cur: Hold still. I want to see what it looks like when the latex comes back.
I haven't tried this part before. Come closer and keep still.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cau: Don't pull away suddenly. Let me hold you steady, then I'll draw the latex back.
Plant your feet. Stay still so I don't hurt you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pro: Come here. I'll hold you so you don't fall when you change back.
Come closer. I'll get a firm hold before I draw the latex back.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.sho: Watch closely. I promise you'll come back exactly as you were.
This is easy. Come here and I'll have you changed back in no time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cal: There's no rush. Come closer and breathe evenly.
Relax. I'll draw the latex back slowly.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.com: You win this round. Come here. I'll draw back every bit of latex.
Fine, you have a point this time. Hold still.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pla: Deal. One last hug, then I'll let you out.
Don't run yet. Come here. This won't take long.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.sen: I know you didn't want this. Come closer. I'll be gentle.
It's all right. I understand. Once you're steady, I'll change you back.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pol: We have an agreement. Please come closer and I'll release you now.
All right. I respect your decision. Please hold still.

dialogue.changed_synergy.white.spotted_h: A real human... don't run. I only want to hear you speak.
Wait. Let me see you clearly. It's been years since we met someone like you.
Everyone stay back. I'll go first. I promise I'm only saying hello.
It's been so long since we found a human... don't be afraid. I can't help wanting closer.
Everyone noticed your warmth at once. May I hold you?
Every voice is urging me to ask... would you become my host?
Human... come closer, and you won't have to remain a visitor.
Don't disappear. Everyone's already wondering what you'll be like among us.
We've waited long enough. Come hear all this noise for yourself.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.spotted_hu: A human... a real one! Don't panic. I just want to hear your voice...
Don't chase them! I've waited too long to scare a human off the moment I start talking...
New face? No, a face we haven't seen in years. Let me greet you.
Everyone back. I will ask. Human, would you become my host?
Don't run. I've waited long enough for this place; I won't damage you.
You showed up and the whole group forgot how to stay quiet. Let me catch up, then we'll talk.
Hey, listen, human! I want you to join us, not just leave you here.
It's been a long time since a new member began as a human. Come here.
Keep up with us. Everyone will remember the day you joined.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.spotted: Your scent... I've only found it in old traces. May I see you clearly?
Don't hide. I won't touch you first. I simply have too many questions.
So this is a living human. Stay a moment. I want to remember you.
I won't change you now. First tell me how you still look human.
You haven't attacked, so neither will I. Any change can wait until we understand each other.
I have wondered how you might change, but not now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.spotted: From the shore... a real human. Don't go yet. Let me hear your voice.
I haven't seen a reflection like yours in years. Will you come closer?
Everyone stay back. I want the first word with this human.
That warmth stands out... let me come closer. Don't be afraid.
Half the water is already watching. Would you become my host?
Don't leave the shore. I finally found someone I want to approach.
It's been years since the water welcomed someone who began human.
Don't fear the water. If you stay, everyone will remember today.
Come closer. I want you to hear the sudden noise beneath the surface.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.spotted_h: Wow, a real human... Don't jump in! Let me look at it properly.
Hmmm, that smell... That's a human smell. I need to greet it!
No pouncing! I saw him first, so I get to greet him.
I knew it was worth coming over. Hey, human, please be my host!
Please, don't run! It's been too long since I found a smell that fits this well!
Hey, human! Don't run! I want to go with you, not hurt you!
Is that a human? Hey, human! Become a member of out pack, so I will know your scent anywhere!
Oh? A chase? I'm in! Let's see how fast my future clanmate can go.
Human, stop! Please don't go! An encounter like this shouln't go to waste.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.relations: Call me %3$s, %1$s. I'll make room for you next time.
Now we know each other, %2$s. I'm %3$s, so you do not need to run.
Remember %3$s, %1$s. I will not rush you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_ta: Want to stay a while? Then stay.
You seem more relaxed than last time.
It's quiet nearby. We can take our time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_pa: I remember your hand. Still gentle.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_fo: All right. You lead. I won't be far.
Lead on. I won't fall far behind.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_wa: I'll stay here. Call when you return.
All right. I will wait here for now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_go: Go on. I'll recognize you next time.
Take it slowly. You don't always have to run away.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.relationsh: All right, %2$s. I'm %3$s. Say hello first next time.
Now we know each other, %1$s. Remember %3$s, and do not mix me up.
The name is %3$s. Next time I see you, I will hear you out first.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_tal: Say what you came to say. I'm listening.
Nothing going on today? Stay and keep an eye on things with me.
You're back. Good. Saves me looking for you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_pat: Friendly all of a sudden? Fine, I'll take it.
Steady hand. Not a bad greeting.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_fol: Let's go. I'll be behind you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_wai: I'll stay here. We can talk when you're back.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_goo: Go on. Next time, don't appear right behind me.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.relatio: I'm %3$s, %1$s. I remember your hand and your scent too.
%2$s, remember %3$s. You will not need to hide next time.
You touched me first, so you get my name. %3$s. We are friends now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.social_: Your heartbeat is steady today. Something good happen?
You've picked up an unfamiliar scent. Where were you?
You can sit a while. I'm in no hurry.
Yes, like that. Don't pull away too quickly.
I know that touch.
Lead on. I'll follow your scent.
Go. You won't need to look back for me.
I'll stay. I'll smell you before I see you return.
All right. Don't forget me here.
Go on. I'll know you when you come close again.
Be careful. Don't come back hurt.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.relatio: Call me %3$s, %1$s. Use that name by the water next time.
Now we know each other, %2$s. I'm %3$s, so you do not need to hide.
You have my name, %1$s. It is %3$s. I will find you first next time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.social_: Anything new happening on shore today?
Good timing. I just heard something moving below.
Stand closer. I don't want to call across the whole bank.
Mm. Your hand is still warm.
Just don't splash water everywhere.
Stay near the water and I'll keep up faster.
Lead on. I can manage the shore.
I'll wait nearby. The water will keep me company.
All right, I won't follow. Call when you return.
See you. Don't show off in deep water.
Go on. Bring me some news from shore next time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.relations: Alright, %2$s. My name is %3$s. I will not chase you the next time I see you, promise.
From now on, we're friends, %1$s. Call me %3$s. Don't you forget my name, okay?
Understood. I see you're not a prey, but an ally instead. I am %3$s, I hope we can be good friends.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_ta: Hmmm, you got smells on you I don't follow. You travelled a lot last time, don't you?
The coast's clear. You can relax here with me.
Ah, you're back, human! Found anything good this time?
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_pa: Hmm, that's a familiar greeting there.
I don't mind being greeted like this all day.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_fo: Want me to follow then? Sure thing, lead the way!
Understood. Just don't take the long road on purpose.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_wa: Okay, I'll be around. Don't take too long.
Alright, I'll check the surroundings, just in case.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_go: Alright, see you later! Bring me something next time we meet!
See you, buddy. Be careful out there.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.relations: I'm still learning your scent. Give it a little time.
You feel more familiar than last time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.relationsh: I remember part of you. I still need to watch you a little longer.
Not bad, but I don't know you well enough yet.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.relatio: I'm beginning to know your scent and footsteps.
Easy. I still want to see what you do next.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.relatio: You're more familiar this time. Scents in the water don't lie.
I remember these hands. I just need a little longer.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.relations: The more greets we make to each other, the easier it is for me to recognize you.
Ah, so that's you scent. Well, half of it, at least.
message.changed_synergy.social.no_gift: Hold the item you want to give, then sneak-right-click to open the social wheel.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.relations: That orange smells bright. Is it for me?
You remembered to bring food. Good. I'll remember this.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_gi: You brought something else? Set it here. I'll keep it safe.
Thank you. I'm happier that you remembered to come back.
Put the hostility down first. A gift won't help right now.
I still remember that wound. Take it back.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.relationsh: An orange? Good preparation. I'll take it.
All right. That's a better greeting than empty hands.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_gif: For me? Fine, I'll take it. You don't need a ceremony next time.
Not a bad choice. You know me a little better than I thought.
Too late. Put away the hostility first.
A gift won't cover this. We settle the trouble first.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.relatio: It smells fresh. Did you bring it for me?
Not too sweet. Good. I'll remember the kindness.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.social_: I'll take it. Your scent is still on it.
This is good. Were you thinking of me when you chose it?
I can smell that you still want to fight. Take it back.
The wound is still there. Don't come closer yet.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.relatio: Fruit from shore? Let me taste it.
I can still smell it in the water. I'll remember this.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.social_: Let me see it before you drop it in the water.
I'll take it. Next time, I'll find you something from below.
The water still carries what happened. Take it back.
Give me some space. I won't take it now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.relations: An orange? Sure thing. I was getting hungry.
Make sure to bring food with you next time we meet. That way, I can remember you a little easier.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_gi: Oh, is that for me? I gladly take it!
Hm, hm, hm. That hit the spot. You're really good at choosing foods alright.
Take that food out of my face! I remember what you did to me last time.
I refuse to accept that from YOU. I haven't forgotten our last encounter.
message.changed_synergy.social.rest_busy: It is not safe enough to rest here.
message.changed_synergy.social.rest_cool: You can rest together again in %1$s seconds.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_re: Come closer. We could both use a moment.
Rest. I'll keep an eye on the room.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_res: Let's rest for a little while... I'll watch the area.
Fine. Tend to the wounds first, then we move.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.social_: Slow your breathing. I'll stay beside you.
Stop for a moment. Wounds need time to close.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.social_: Lean against me and breathe slowly.
Stay here. The water will cover our noise.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_re: Okay, let's take a breather. There's no rush or anything.
Inhale. Exhale. Catch your breath before continuing.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_ta: Easy. I am hurting more than I let on. Just sit close.
I am fine... all right, maybe let me lean on you for a minute.
You do not look well. Come here. The talking can wait.
Do not pretend you are fine. Everyone can hear your breathing go uneven.
The rain has everyone's thoughts tumbling together. Listen, it is rather lively.
Come closer. Getting wet is harmless, but I do not want you cold.
It is quiet tonight. Everyone keeps listening for you.
Still awake? Then keep watch with me for a while.
Whenever you arrive, everyone knows I will drift this way. They know me too well.
We do not need a subject. I feel better with you here.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_pl: Race you around that rock. First one back wins.
Hey, catch me! ... I am teasing.
Everyone is watching. Come have some fun with me.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_tal: Hold up. I need a breath. Stop looking so worried.
I can still stand. Sit close, and keep it between us.
You can barely stand, and you want to talk? Come here. We deal with the wound first.
Stop forcing it. Breathe with me, slowly.
The rain covers our footsteps. Good. We can slack off for a minute.
This weather is good for sticking together. No one gets lost that way.
I have the night watch. You can share it, but do not fall asleep.
Quiet all around. Go on, I am listening.
Good, you are here. No, that was not an order.
I do not have to stay on guard with you. It is nice once in a while.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_pla: One lap? No excuses if you lose.
Come on. Let us see if you can keep up.
I could use the exercise. You pick a direction, and I will get there first.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.social_: Come closer. I still hurt, and I do not want to raise my voice.
Avoid the wound. Anywhere else... you can stay close.
You smell like blood. Do not tell me it is nothing. Let me see.
Your breathing is uneven. Sit. I will watch over you.
Rain washes the scents thin. Stay close so I can find you.
I like the rain. It makes a heartbeat sound nearer.
Breathing carries clearly after dark. Yours does too.
Do not worry about the dark. Stay close. I know your steps.
I knew your scent before I saw you. Mm, welcome back.
Once I hear your heartbeat nearby, I stop wanting you to leave.
Move a little. I want to see how quick you are today.
Are you hidden? I can still smell you.
Come on, do not just stand there. Move with me.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.social_: Give me a minute. Even the water cannot dull this ache.
Let me rest by the bank. We can talk when it eases.
Your breathing is wrong. Sit by the water. I am here.
Keep that wound out of the water. Come let me see it.
Every raindrop wakes the water. Can you hear it?
In weather like this, shore and water feel the same. Come closer.
Moonlight is on the water. Good night for a slow conversation.
Sound carries clearly across the water at night. You can speak softly.
When you come close, the water sounds familiar again. Welcome back.
Whichever way you come from, I always know your steps first.
Race along the bank? I am not giving you a head start.
Throw something into the water and I will fetch it. Keep it close.
Come on, one lap through the shallows. Least splashing wins.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_ta: I've seen better days. I don't mind taking a quick break.
Hey, I may be banged up, but I can keep going.
I smell that wound of yours. Don't play though on me. I don't mind taking a rest.
Hey, partner, your steps are unsteady. You thought I wouldn't see that? A small rest won't do us any harm, yeah?
Ah... I really enjoy the rain. It's just a shame it can wash tracks from our preys.
What an unfortunate rain! It will make it harder for us to pinpoint our targets.
Nighttime is when things get actually interesting! Look, something moved over there!
Tired, buddy? No worries. Let's seat here. You can lean on me if you feel sleepy.
No need to be close to me. I knew it was you from miles away.
It's nice to have you around, specially since I don't have go out looking for you, hehe...
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_pl: Want to compete with me? Okay, what's the game?
Hey, don't just stay there, or I'll leave you behind!
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cur: Let us try something different. You go first. I want to see.
Something moved over there. Want to have a look with me?
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cau: We can play, but do not leap at me without warning. Start slowly.
Let us stay close. I do not want you running out of sight.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pro: Do not run too far. I can play and still watch our surroundings.
All right, but stay where I can reach you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.sho: Watch closely. I am only doing this once.
I needed an audience. Your timing is excellent.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.cal: There is no need to rush. A slow lap still counts.
We can stay here for a while. Quiet company is good too.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.com: If we compete, take it seriously. I will not go easy on you.
Pick the finish line first. No excuses when you lose.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pla: Finally ready to play? Catch me first.
I already have a game in mind. Do not ask. Just follow.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.sen: Easy. I do not like sudden, loud movement.
All right, but tell me which way we are running first.
dialogue.changed_synergy.personality.pol: Of course. How would you like to play?
We can play for a while. Tell me when you are tired.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.relations: How did you know I like this? I am going to remember you much more clearly now.
You put more thought into this than a spare orange. Thank you.
You even worked out my favorite food, %1$s? Then let us meet properly. I am %3$s.
That was a perfect choice, %2$s. I am %3$s. We can stop testing each other now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_di: Thank you, %1$s. You really remembered what I like.
For me? This is just right, %2$s.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.cat_orang: Wait, do not peel it! That smell is strong enough to make my head pull back.
Could you move the orange away? The smell is far too sharp for me.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.friend_re: With your friend beside you, we'll trust you.
Your friend vouched for you, so I will not chase. Come say hello.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_frien: Your friend said you were safe. All right, I accept the greeting.
So these are the hands they trusted. I understand now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.pat_playe: Easy. Your friend is right here. I only want to say hello too.
They are willing to trust you, and so am I. Come a little closer.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.compatrio: You are hurting my %1$s! Everyone, stop them!
Protect the %1$s first. Do not let that human get close again!
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_witn: %2$s, stop! That is my %3$s. How can I speak for you when you do this?
%1$s, please stop. They are my %3$s. I cannot pretend I did not see it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.friend_wi: %2$s, I just spoke for you, and now you are attacking my %3$s? Stop!
Friend, do not hurt my %3$s. If you continue, I will have to stop you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_pl: %1$s, come here. We agreed to play, so I am catching you for a hug first.
Caught you, %2$s. Relax. I will only hold you for a moment.
%1$s, come closer. Playing with you suddenly made me want a hug.
Got you, %2$s. Just for a moment, all right?
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.relationsh: Good choice. You did not just grab the first food you found.
Exactly my taste. All right, I will remember this.
You even got my taste right, %2$s. Fine. I am %3$s, and from now on we are friends.
That made your point clearly, %1$s. Remember the name %3$s.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_die: Not bad, %1$s. You really did remember my taste.
Good pick, %2$s. I am not sharing this one.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.cat_orange: Move the orange away. That smell is too sharp to think through.
No. One sniff, and that sour smell takes over everything.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.friend_res: Your friend is here. If they are willing to stand up for you, I will trust you once.
Your friend accepts you, so we will make room. Don't betray our trust.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_friend: Your friend already spoke for you. Fine, I accept the greeting.
Keep your hand steady. They trust you, so I will give you a chance.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.pat_player: Do not dodge. Your friend is here, and I am not going to try anything.
They accept you. I may as well greet you properly too.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.compatriot: Our %1$s is under attack. Get over here. Do not let them leave!
You attack a %1$s in front of us? Everyone, pin them down!
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_witne: %1$s, stop! That is my %3$s. Don't embarrass me here.
%2$s, look at me. Lower your hand and leave my %3$s alone.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.friend_wit: %2$s, I vouched for you, and now you are attacking my %3$s? Stop!
%1$s, trust is not something you get to use like this. Back away from my %3$s.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_pla: Too slow, %1$s. I caught you. Hold still for a moment.
That means I win, %2$s. Relax, I will let go in a moment.
You did not dodge, %1$s. Then I get one hug.
Caught you, %2$s! It's all right, I'm only playing.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.relatio: This smells just right. Did you choose it for me?
I like this. You really have been watching me.
You even know what I like to eat, %1$s? I am %3$s. We do not need to be strangers now.
%2$s, I will remember this food and you with it. Call me %3$s.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.social_: Thank you, %1$s. I can smell that you chose this for me.
You still remember my taste, %2$s. Good.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.cat_ora: No, that is much too sharp. Bring meat or fish instead.
Put it away for now. That smell makes me want to step back.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.friend_: Your friend is here. They trust you, so I will put my claws away.
I can tell you know each other well. If they stand for you, I will not chase.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_fri: Your friend accepted these hands. All right, I will try too.
No hostility. It seems they judged you well.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.pat_pla: Do not back away. Your friend is here. I only want to touch you.
They recognize you. I want to remember your touch too.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.compatr: You hurt my %1$s. Do not blame us for coming together.
They are bleeding. Stop that human before they touch the %1$s again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_wi: Stop, %2$s. You are hurting my %3$s. I cannot ignore that.
%1$s, let go! Don't make me choose between you and %3$s.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.friend_: %2$s, I called you a friend, and you hurt my %3$s? Enough.
%1$s, back away. I will not let you keep hurting my %3$s.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.social_: %1$s, come closer. A hug is more interesting than running in circles.
Caught you, %2$s. Do not worry. I only wanted to feel your warmth.
Do not go stiff, %1$s. I only want a hug.
You are warmer than I expected, %2$s. All right, I will let go.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.relatio: Now that is a familiar smell. You know how to choose.
For me? This is exactly right. I will remember you.
You even know what I like to eat, %1$s. Call me %3$s.
Perfect choice, %2$s. I am %3$s. Call for me next time you reach the water.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.social_: Thank you, %1$s. You remembered what I like down here.
This needs to be fresh, %2$s. Your timing was perfect.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.cat_ora: Move it away. That sour smell travels even farther through water.
No oranges. I can smell that one through the water, and it is awful.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.friend_: Your friend is by the water. They trust you, so I will not pull you in.
With your friend beside you, this water is open to you for now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_fri: Your friend spoke for you. All right, I accept.
Your hand is warm. No wonder they trust you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.pat_pla: Do not mind the splash. Your friend is here. I only want one touch.
They trust you, and I want a closer look too. Hold still.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.compatr: Our %1$s is being attacked! Surround them. Do not let the human slip away!
The whole water heard it. Protect the %1$s and catch that human!
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_wi: %1$s, let go! That is my %3$s. Do not hurt them in front of me.
%2$s, back away. If this continues, I will not know which side to stand on.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.friend_: %2$s, I vouched for you in this water, and you hurt my %3$s? Stop!
%1$s, get away from my %3$s. Do not make me regret trusting you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.social_: %1$s, this time I am scooping you into my arms. Do not swim off yet.
Caught you, %2$s. Floating quietly still counts as play.
%1$s, come here. Let me hold you for a moment.
Got you, %2$s. Do not thrash. I will not drag you under.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.relations: Hm, hm. That sure hit the spot. Thank you very much, partner! You really know my tastes.
Oh, so you knew I liked this a lot. You really know me very well.
You knew very well my type of food, %2$s. Alright, my name is %3$s, and as long as you carry such delicious foods, I'll be your partner.
Ah, winning me over with food, %1$s. You really know me well! %3$s, that's my name, don't forget it!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_di: I never get tired of eating this, %1$s. You really know me well.
That's one good food choice, %2$s. Don't worry, I'll recognize both that food and your smell next time you're around.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.cat_orang: UGH! That smell makes my nose all itchy!
AHH! Take that smell away! It... Makes me... Want to... Sneeze!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.friend_re: I see a friend is tagging with you. As long as they trust you, I won't chase you.
I respect the friendship that connect you both. Say no more, come over and let me get your scent.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_frien: So your friend was right; your greeting is kind of weird, but very pleasing.
That's one friendly greeting alright! It seems your friend judged you well.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.pat_playe: Hey! If your friend can pat you, then I want to pat you too!
The trust between you two is real. I would love to memorize that smell of yours, should we encounter paths again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.compatrio: Why you attacked my %1$s? This means war!
Our %1$s is under attack! ¡Everyone, fend off our enemies!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_witn: Hey, %2$s! That is my %3$s. Are you nuts?
Hey, %1$s! Stop, now! I won't tolerate you hurting my %3$s!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.friend_wi: %2$s, I always steemed you, and yet you dare attack my %3$s? Back off, now!
%1$s, stop! If you hit again, I will be the one chasing you away.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_pl: Aha! Caught you, %1$s! You though I was going to transfur you? Nah, it's just a hug, silly.
Oho! So you're approaching me, %2$s! If you want a hug, then come as close as you want!
Got you, %1$s! Oh, don't worry, this is just a hug.
So, %2$s, you decided to take the road of the hugs, eh?
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_pl: There you go, %1$s. Back on your feet.
All right, %2$s, I am letting go. Come close again whenever you like.
Easy, %1$s. I have got you safely back down.
That was enough for now, %2$s. You may step away.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_pla: All right, %1$s. Feet down. Do not grin at me.
Released, %2$s. Stay close if you want another round.
There, %1$s. You are back on your feet.
That will do, %2$s. I am letting you go.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.social_: Steady, %1$s. I am setting you down now.
All right, %2$s. I have loosened my hold.
Back on the ground, %1$s. Are you steady?
There, %2$s. You can move again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.social_: There you go, %1$s. I will let you drift free.
All right, %2$s. Swim on when you are ready.
Easy, %1$s. I am letting you go now.
There, %2$s. No splashing on the way out.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_pl: Alright, %1$s. That was a nice hug. I won't mind going for another.
Okay, %2$s, I'm letting you go. That was fun!
Alright, %1$s. Time to continue with our shores.
That was really fun, %2$s! Let me know if you want to play again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.friend_co: %1$s, get behind me. That creature is coming for you.
Stay close, %2$s. We can drive it away together.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.faction_c: %1$s, stay close to us. You will not face this alone here.
We all saw that. Step back a little, %1$s.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.white_ter: We all felt that. Come closer, and we will stop it together.
That pain reached us. Fall back this way and do not let it touch you again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.white_hiv: Hss... all of us will remember that hit.
That hurt. Do not let it slip out of our sight.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.friend_ki: You killed my %3$s. %1$s, put the weapon down.
I spoke for you, but I will not watch you hurt my %3$s. Stop now.
Enough, %2$s. Too many of us are gone. I cannot call you a friend now.
I gave you a chance. Stay away from my %3$s.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.friend_be: Do not touch me. A pat cannot undo what happened.
Take your hand back, %2$s. I am not ready to forgive you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.friend_com: %1$s, move behind me. I have this one.
Stay on my side, %2$s. We will put it down together.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.faction_co: %1$s, fall in behind us. We will handle this.
It attacked you in front of us? Stay close, %1$s.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.friend_kin: That was my %3$s, %2$s. Lower the weapon. Now.
%1$s, I trusted you near our group. Do not make that a mistake.
That is enough. You chose to keep killing us, so we are done.
No more warnings, %2$s. Get away from my %3$s.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.friend_bet: Hand off. You cannot smooth this over with a pat.
Not now, %2$s. You broke my trust.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.friend_: %1$s, stay close. I can keep its attention off you.
I can smell its anger, %2$s. Let me meet it first.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.faction: %1$s, step back. I will hold it here.
I remember your scent. Do not push yourself, %1$s.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.white_t: We felt it too. Come closer while I pin it down.
Get back among us. I will bite down and keep it away.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.white_h: Hss... I felt that, and now everyone knows where it is.
I remember that claw. The others do too.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.friend_: My %3$s is dead. %1$s, back away before I turn on you.
I still know you as a friend, but that scent is changing. Stop.
No. I know what you are to us now. Get away.
Too many of my %3$s are gone, %2$s. I will not let you take another.
Do not reach for me. I have not forgotten.
Keep your hand back, %2$s. I do not trust your touch now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.friend_: %1$s, stay by me. I will cut it off.
It is coming straight for you, %2$s. Let me intercept it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.faction: %1$s, over here! I will cut it off.
It is coming for you. Stay near me, %1$s.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.friend_: You killed my %3$s. %1$s, stop before this water turns against you.
I let you move safely among us. Do not make me regret it.
Enough, %2$s. You are no friend of mine after this.
Stay away from my %3$s. I will not warn you again.
No. Keep your hand out of my reach.
A gentle touch will not wash this away, %2$s.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.friend_co: %1$s, there's an enemy over there! Back off, I'll take it out!
¡%2$s! Are you okay? I'm going to obliterate that thing!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.faction_c: %1$s, come over here! Let's take it down together.
So that thing decided to take the path of violence. Fine, %1$s, let's go after it!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.friend_ki: Hey, that was my %3$s! %1$s, have you gone mad?! Stop righ this instant!
I though we were friends. Don't make me chose between you and my %3$s.
No more! I won't take anymore of that from you! Stay away from me!
This is over, %2$s. You are no longer a friend. Come near my %3$s again and I will bring you down, mark my words!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.friend_be: How you dare... I'm still mad at you!
Hands off, %2$s. You won't distract me this time with that.
