dialogue.changed_synergy.role.role_scout: I got a good view. Follow that one.
There. Don't lose track of them.
dialogue.changed_synergy.role.role_guard: Stay behind me. I will go first.
dialogue.changed_synergy.role.role_forag: This is useful. I'll hold onto it.
Safe. It's there when anyone needs it.
A fine addition to our collection.
dialogue.changed_synergy.role.role_provi: Here, for you, %1$s. You've been nice to us lately.
Good timing. You can keep this %1$s.
I kept a %1$s just for you. Take it.
A %1$s, for you. It reminded me of you.
Catch! It's a %1$s. You looked like you could use some.
Good timing. I took this %1$s from the outpost for you.
Here. The best %1$s we have, just for you.
Catch! Of course you get the %1$s first, partner.
I saved this %1$s just for you. Come on, I'll hand it to you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.role.role_fishi: Stay away from the water. You'll scare off the fish.
Go fish somewhere else. I don't trust you enough to share this spot.
Shh! Easy steps. The fish are just about to bite.
Try not to disturb the waters. Everything only just settled down.
Oh, it's you. Keep your voice low whilst I fish.
Give me a minute, then we can talk. The fish are just about to bite.
Good timing. You want to watch the waters with me?
Help me reel this one in. I can't quite pull it in.
Quiet. Help me watch over the fish, then we can talk.
Tread carefully. You get a share of today's catch too.
Not now. The fish are right here. Let me catch some first.
You may come closer, just stay away from the water. These fish are shy.
Quiet. You get the first one I reel in.
Stay close and keep still. The fish is coming closer.
dialogue.changed_synergy.role.role_caret: There's food to spare. Catch your breath.
Don't push yourself too much. Let me take care of you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.role.role_couri: This needs to be stored. Give me some room to get through.
dialogue.changed_synergy.role.role_looko: Something moved there. Stay on guard.
Look that way. We can't rest yet.
dialogue.changed_synergy.role.role_coord: Match your paces. Don't rush ahead.
Stay together and keep watch of the ones beside you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.role.role_wande: This place is empty. I will find another spot.
There might be a better way. I will take a look.
dialogue.changed_synergy.role.role_young: Mrrp! I'm too small for this!
Wait for me! Don't leave me behind!
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.community: The echoes here are fading. We will flow somewhere else for a while.
There is less to find nearby. We can meet again in a new place.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.community_: We have searched this patch clean. Pack up and move on.
The stores are falling behind. No lingering. Move.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.community: Hmmm... Seems there's nothing else for use around here. Let's check far ahead and see what can we find.
This was a good place, but no longer offers anything good. Time to move out, people.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.communi: This stretch of water is picked clean. We will follow the current onward.
The water is too quiet here. Let us try the next reach.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.communi: There is not enough food here. We should move instead of waiting.
The scent is getting faint. There may be supplies farther on.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.white_ref: I came back over here. It saved me the long way around.
The ground knew where I was. I only changed places.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.routine_r: I am going quiet for a while. The others are still close in my thoughts.
Everyone has this place covered. I will rest and join them again soon.
There is still a blank patch over there. I am going to have a look.
I feel like making a round. Whatever I find will reach the others.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.routine_p: Something stirred around here. I will circle past it.
I will check the edge. The rest of you can keep going.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.routine_f: There is a fresh scent nearby. I am going to find it.
Something is over there. I will tell everyone once I know what it is.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.routine_s: Someone over there is thinking about me. I should visit.
It suddenly went quiet over there. I will keep them company.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.routine_w: Wait a moment. I want to listen.
The sounds around here are muddled. I will watch for a while.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.routine_c: Come closer. We will not need to say everything one piece at a time.
There, we are connected. What were you thinking about?
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.routine_re: I am taking a breather. Call me if anyone turns up.
I am off this watch for a moment. Do not slack off while my eyes are shut.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.routine_ro: I am walking the outer path. My legs are getting stiff standing here.
Nothing nearby needs me. I will make a quick round.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.routine_pa: I am making a round. Shout if you spot trouble.
I have this stretch. Do not let anyone slip past.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.routine_fo: Supplies will not walk over by themselves. I am going to look.
I will see what is useful nearby and leave some for the next partner.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.routine_so: That partner over there looks idle. I am going to bother them.
You still have to tell someone when the watch changes. I will go check.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.routine_wa: Look first, move second. No sense making everyone run for nothing.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.routine_re: That is far enough. Time to get back near the group.
The outer path is clear. I am going back to check in.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.routine_r: I've ran too much already. Let me take a rest.
Ooof... That sure drained my energy. Let me take a five minute nap.
That looks promising. Wonder if there's anything valuable around here...
Hmm... Something smell good around there. Let's follow that trail.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.routine_p: Nothing around here to report. Let's check that patch over there...
Patroling is so boring... But someone has to do it, I guess.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.routine_f: I can feel it! Something good is hiding nearby!
Well, there's not much for me around here. Let's check somewhere else.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.routine_s: I hear something familiar. Is that a packmate over there?
Something is moving over there. Wonder who might be...
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.routine_w: Shh! I think I heard something over there.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.routine_r: Oops! I think I've gone to far from the outpost. Better head back now.
Alright, let's head back. Maybe I'll explore further another day.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.routine: I need a breather. Sit if you want, but do not step on me.
I am resting. Chasing scents gets tiring too.
The scent has faded here. I will check somewhere else.
It is too quiet nearby. I am making a round in case I missed something.
Those footsteps are unfamiliar. I am going to check them.
I am circling back. That last scent was wrong.
I am hungry. Time to find something I can eat.
There is food over there. I hope nobody was saving it.
I hear familiar breathing over there. I am going to look.
Someone sounds like they are looking for company. I will show myself.
Do not make a sound. I am working out what that was.
Stay back for a moment. Let me catch the scent.
I have gone too far from the familiar scents. Time to turn back.
I do not recognize any traces here. I am heading back.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.routine: I am going where the water is calmer to rest.
Swimming slowly feels good too. I will drift here for a while.
The current bends that way. I am going to follow it.
The water ahead feels different. I will make a round.
I am swimming this route once more.
Something passed underneath a moment ago. I am going to look.
There is a fresh scent in the water. I will find it.
I hear little splashes over there. There may be food nearby.
Someone is splashing over there. It sounds like they are calling me.
I know that sound in the water. I am going to say hello.
Keep the water still. I want to listen below us.
The current just shifted. Let me see why.
I swam too far. I should follow the current back.
I do not know the sound of this water. I am going back to the others.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_ta: You came back. Everyone is still guessing how long you will stay this time.
I remember you. I just need a little more time to know you.
Good timing. I was just thinking about you.
Come closer. We do not have to choose every word so carefully now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.social_pa: Slowly... all right, I know it is you.
I am still getting used to that greeting.
You already know where I like to be patted.
I knew your hand before it touched me.
Stay a little longer. The others will stop teasing us eventually.
Yes... right there. You always remember.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_tal: No need to give your name again. I remember you.
We meet again. Tell me what brought you here.
Good timing. The others were just asking about you.
Stand over here. You do not need to talk around me.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.social_pat: Wait... fine. I will not move away this time.
I am not used to it yet, but you can continue.
Not bad. I did teach you well.
Only for a moment. The others will tease me if they see this.
Do not stop. I never said I had to act tough this time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.social_: I know your scent now. We are not close yet, but I know it.
Do not stand so far away. I only want to hear you breathe clearly.
You seem calm today. This place no longer makes you nervous.
Come sit down. You do not need to watch my claws anymore.
Gently. I am still learning the feel of your hand.
Your hand is warm... all right, I will stay.
I knew it was you by scent. Keep going.
You did not startle me this time.
Come a little closer. It is warmer that way.
You know my favorite spot. Do not pretend you forgot.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.social_: I remember you visiting. The scent of dry land is easy to recognize.
Come closer if you want to talk. Do not make me guess through the water.
There you are. Walk along the shore with me for a while.
I can recognize you by your footsteps now.
Slow down. Scales are not stone.
Hold out your hand. Let me see it first.
That is the warmth I remember.
I did not splash you this time. That is progress.
Keep going. I do not want to swim away yet.
Come closer. The water is a little cold.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_ta: That is one slightly familar smell... Calm down, I've just said 'slightly', don't look so pleased.
Okay, you're here now. What you want to talk with me about?
Hey, been some time already since we talked. I needed some company, so why don't stick together for a while?
Hello there. Sit here with me, I saved you a place.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.social_pa: Hey, hey, slow down. I'm still not fully used to you yet.
Y'know, that was not a bad greeting at all.
Ah, nice pat there. Hey, I've never told you to stop!
I knew you were going to pat me! I saw your instentions miles away!
Awww, only one pat? Come one, gimme one more.
Ah yes, that's more like it. You did remember!
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.organic: Hold still, %2$s. You are badly hurt. I am taking you out of here.
Let me hold you. We can talk once we are somewhere safe.
Come here, %1$s. I will cover you while we get out.
Stop pushing yourself. Hold on and let me carry you.
Hold tight, %2$s. Do not look back.
Come into my arms. I will handle the rest of the way.
We are safe for now. Take your time standing up.
They did not follow us. Catch your breath.
All right, %1$s. We can rest here for a moment.
Do not rush back. You are still hurt.
We are safe, %2$s. I am putting you down.
Can you stand? Lean on me a little longer if you need to.
dialogue.changed_synergy.centaur.white_c: Ok, partner. Check the straps, I will not move at all.
%2$s, did you checked both sides? Just double check to be sure.
Ok, partner, the tack is in your hands. Just go slowly while I get used to this.
I trust you with this. If a strap pinches, I'll let you know.
Ok, I think we're ready. Hold onto my waist when you climb up, and watch your footing!
Buckles secured. I'll wait for you once you're seated to start our trip.
This feels actually very nice. Ease into the saddle instead of my back.
The saddle is now ready, partner. We're ready to start the adventure.
This packs feels really comfortable. Whenever you need to check it, just let me know.
I can feel both sides very well balanced, partner.
Need to carry anything? I can handle it. Just make sure the weight is even.
Nicely fitted. Just make sure to place lighter things on top, so they won't rattle all the way.
Take what you need, %1$s. Just make sure to keep the balance on both sides.
Take your time, %2$s. I'll wait for you, right here.
Ouch! Oi, partner, don't knock the lid against me. I felt that...
You sure have a lot of stuff in there. Make sure it is all tied up.
Let's move out, partner! You choose the destiny, and I will take us there.
%2$s, hold my waist and let me know if you want to speed up a little.
Hey, friend. Let me walk a few steps first, so I can find my rythm.
So, you're settled? Alright, I'll slow down before each turn, just in case.
We're here, buddy. No need to rush. Take your time to pack out.
%2$s, watch your footing. I'll wait until you are ready to go.
That was one cool trip! I would love to do it again sometime.
And... We're here. If your legs are sitff, you can lean on me.
dialogue.changed_synergy.centaur.gnoll_t: Hahaha! Hey, partner! Careful with that buckle, it tickles!
Take your time, %2$s. With four feet, it is unlikely for me to trip over.
Okay, buddy. You can check my tack. Just don't reach my underbelly without warning...
Don't you DARE to pinch me, or I will take my revenge.
Ah, that fits nice. With my four feet, we'll get to your destination in no time.
The saddle is set up alright. Just tap on my shoulder when you are seated and ready to roll.
Not bad, friend. Sit in slowly, while I learn how to stay balannced.
It fits alright. Just don't sway from side to side, or we'll trip over, ok?
The chests are now in place. Make sure to leave some room for my snacks.
Equal weight on both sides means me running faster. You really nailed it this time.
Want me to carry some things? Sure, buddy. Just don't place a stack of bottles in there. I really hate them.
Make sure all is packed up properly. If something starts to rattle, I'll turn to investigate.
What did you pack? Every smell escaped the moment you opened that lid.
%2$s, while you're checking the pack, can you pass me my snacks?
Take your time, buddy. We don't anything spilling, specially on my feet.
Haven't found what you're looking for? Check the other side.
Hold on tight, partner. I will not dawdle once the trip starts.
%2$s, sit tight. I can foresee a clear trip, so I am able to pick up my pace.
Ok, friend. Make sure to tell me ahead of time if we're going for a turn.
Let's try a short stretch first. Make sure to keep your balance, so we can go faster later.
We made it! I kept a steady pace, right?
The trip has come to its end. If you want to praise me, partner, now's the time.
Easy now, friend. The last thing I need is for you to trip over now that we've arrived.
That was one lovely trip, I'd say. Next time you can loosen your grip. I promise I won't throw you.
menu.changed_synergy.centaur_mount.title: Mount Gear
menu.changed_synergy.centaur_mount.cargo: Fit a chest in the right slot first. A chest cannot be removed while its pack contains items.
Fit a saddle in the left slot first.
message.changed_synergy.centaur_mount.re: They do not trust you with their tack yet. Get a little closer first.
message.changed_synergy.centaur_mount.bu: They are too busy to sort out their tack right now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.reputatio: We remember what you did. No one here is stepping aside for you.
There you are. Everyone felt you cross the boundary. Turn back.
We know your face, but not fondly. Stay where we can see you.
You have left us uneasy before. Give us a reason not to call the others over.
Oh, it is you. The others have mentioned you. Come closer, slowly.
Your name has been going around. You are not quite a stranger now.
You are back! Good. Everyone can relax now that they know it is you.
We know you. Come in; someone will be glad you came.
There you are! We felt you coming. It is good to have you with us again.
You are here. The whole group just relaxed a little.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.reputation: Contact. It is them. Close ranks and give them no room.
You picked the wrong group to cross twice. Hold your ground.
We know you. Stay where I can see you, and this stays simple.
You have caused trouble before. Do not make the rest of us step in.
I know that face. You have dealt fairly enough with us.
You are the one people keep mentioning. All right, come through.
Good, it is you. I can lower my guard a little.
You have proven yourself. Come stand with us.
There you are. Good timing. This side just became much easier.
One of our best friends is back. Try not to make the rest of us look slow.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.reputat: I know that scent. Stay back. I will not give you another opening.
You hurt too many of us for me to ignore that smell.
I remember your scent, and the memory is not pleasant. Keep your distance.
We have crossed paths before. Move slowly and keep this calm.
I know that scent. We have met before, have we not?
You are familiar now. I do not need to watch every step you take.
I recognized you before I saw you. Come closer.
Good, it is you. I can relax around a familiar presence.
I would know you anywhere. Come here; you are safe beside me.
That familiar heartbeat... good. I was hoping you would return.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.reputat: You again. The water carries bad memories of you.
Stay out of our water. We are not letting this pass again.
I remember the trouble around you. Keep some distance.
You are familiar, but not in a good way. Do not stir things up.
Oh, I know you! You do not pass through here like a stranger anymore.
Back again? Good, I was wondering where that familiar wake came from.
There you are! Come along, I know a calmer route through here.
I know you. Stay close and the others will leave you be.
You are back! This place was getting dull without you.
Come on. I saved the best current for good company.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.reputatio: That nasty smell again. I recognize it from anywhere.
You dare to came around again? Fine! I'll take you down this time.
I recognize that trail you have left around. Do not attack anyone and we'll be fine.
I see you. However, I don't know your intentions...
Hey, I know that scent. Lost something around here?
Huh, you again. Your visit around is not just a simple coincidence, is it?
Aha! There you are! I though for a moment you found a better trail.
Ah, it is you! Come over one sec, I think there's something around worth checking.
You're back! I was starting to miss that scent of yours!
Perfect timing! Things were kinda boring without you around.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.low_reput: The others are still wary of you... but I felt that. I will stop too.
You reached out first? All right, I will not chase. We can take the rest slowly.
For me? All right, I will take it. The others still have their guard up.
I will remember the gesture. Keep a little space for now, and we can take this slowly.
You even knew what I like... all right. I can trust you a little this time.
This is exactly right. The others are still wary, but I am willing to hear you out.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.low_reputa: After all that, you still reached out. Bold. Fine, we have a truce.
Keep your hand steady. I understand, but do not assume everything is settled.
Food as a peace offering? Fine. I will take it and stop the chase.
That shows some sense. Do not rush us. We still need to see what you do next.
You still knew what to pick. Good. This says more than an apology.
Exactly my taste. I will put in a good word for you this time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.low_rep: Your hand is shaking, but you reached out anyway... all right. I will not chase.
I remember your scent and the trouble around it. Let us be still for a while.
You came closer with food? Hm... I will take it and let you breathe.
The scent is honest. You mean well this time, and I will remember it.
That is a scent I like. You chose it for me? Then I can come a little closer.
Exactly right... fine. I will leave the old trouble alone for now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.low_rep: Word travels through the water. You still reached out... fine, I will stop chasing.
Steady your hand. You are stirring the water. Fine, I know you want peace.
Offering this for a breather? All right, I will take it.
I caught the scent in the water. The gesture is real, so we can pause.
Now this tastes right. You even found this for me, so I will hear you out.
Fresh and just right. Fine, I will not chase you today.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.low_reput: You know the reputation you have, and still pat me? You either are brave or crazy, but that's fine. I respect that.
That pat was sus... Alright, I'll let you go for now, just don't try anything funny.
Huh? Is this a peace offering? Fine, I'll take it. We're good... For now.
Okay, I accept it as an apology. We'll continue this another day.
Well, that was actually tasty. Very well, that gives you a bit of peace. Make good use of it.
Ah, that hit the spot! I'll forgive you for now, just don't try anything dumb again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.cache_int: Wait. We gathered those together. Step away from the barrel, please.
Hands back, please. Those haven't been shared with you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.cache_tol: Please ask our provisioner if you need something. The shared stores stay closed until we count you as an ally.
We know you, but take supplies through an exchange for now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.cache_fin: Please stop trying the store. Ask our provisioner if you need supplies.
Everyone noticed. The provisioner can arrange a fair exchange; the store itself stays closed.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.cache_ove: You have opened it several times. Put the lid down now.
Enough. Knowing you does not mean you can keep digging through it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.cache_all: Everyone accepts you as an ally. Take whatever you need.
No need to count visits. Just leave a little for whoever comes next.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.cache_des: You broke the cache? Stop. Every one of us knows it was you.
We gathered that piece by piece. Get away from what is left.
We trusted you. Why would you break what everyone shared?
We made room for you, but you tore apart everyone's stores.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.cache_intr: Stop. We left those supplies here for our own.
Step away from the barrel. We did not set this aside for you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.cache_tole: You have earned respect, not a share of the stores. Trade with our provisioner.
Ask the provisioner. The cache opens only to one of ours.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.cache_fina: Second attempt. Speak to the provisioner and stop testing the lock.
Last warning. Leave the cache alone or we will drive you out.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.cache_over: You came back too soon. Close the barrel and step away.
That's enough. Keep rummaging and you're stealing.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.cache_alli: One of ours does not need to report every visit. Take what you need and leave some behind.
The Wolf King accepts you. Who else needs to approve a barrel? Take whatever you need.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.cache_dest: You smashed the outpost barrel! Guards, stop them!
Bold move. First we drive you out, then we count what you ruined.
We gave you clearance, and you smashed the outpost barrel? Guards, stop them!
We accepted you. Don't make that trust look foolish.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.cache_int: Hey, we've just gathered that! Don't touch it!
You are NOT authorized to check that. Hands off!
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.cache_tol: Need something? Talk with our provisioner and trade for it. We still need such provisions.
We trust you, but our supplies are somewhat limited. If you need anything, talk with the provisioner.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.cache_fin: Checking our supplies again? We've told you already; talk with the provisioner first. If you do it again, there'll be consequences.
This is your final warning; stop checking the cache, or we'll start chasing you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.cache_ove: Woah, again? Stop checking the barrel for a while, would you?
We recognize you, but we don't accept you checking the barrel all day. Close it, now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.cache_all: Ah, it's you! Need something from our storage?
Hey there! You can take anything you want, just don't empty the whole thing, okay?
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.cache_des: Hey! rummaging was one thing, but breaking the barrel? Now you'll pay for it!
How could you? That was everyone's effort destroyed now! You'll have to answer for what you did!
Are you serious? We let you take what you needed, and you broke the whole thing down?
POV: When you give your whole trust, just to be treated like this.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.cache_i: Hey, we gathered that along the shore. Stop rummaging.
Hands off the barrel. Those supplies aren't free loot.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.cache_t: Ask the shore provisioner if you need supplies. Do not take them straight from the cache.
We know you; that is why we will trade. The stores themselves stay closed.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.cache_f: Second attempt. Trade with the provisioner instead, or the guards will chase you from shore.
Final warning. Leave the shore cache alone.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.cache_o: Back again? Close the lid this time.
You have dipped in too often. Step back and let it rest.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.cache_a: The shore stores include your share. Take what you need.
You are one of us. No need to watch our faces every time you open it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.cache_d: The barrel is gone! We hauled that in one trip at a time. Stop them!
You broke the shore cache? You are not slipping away that easily.
You already had a share. Why break the whole barrel?
We shared our shore stores with you, and you tore them apart?
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.cache_i: Do not touch that barrel. I know who carried in every scent.
Back away. This place gathered that food for itself.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.cache_t: Ask our provisioner. Respect earns a fair exchange, not an open store.
I know your scent, but the cache stays closed until you are fully accepted.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.cache_f: This is your second attempt. Speak to the provisioner instead.
Last chance. I remember every attempt; leave the cache alone.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.cache_o: You have returned several times. Leave the barrel now.
Enough. I remember what you took each time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.cache_a: Your scent belongs here. Take what you need.
You do not need my permission. We already counted a share for you.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.cache_d: Stop. You broke this place's stores. I will not let you walk away.
The barrel split, and every scent inside scattered. Now I remember yours.
I know your scent, and I remember trusting it. Stop now.
I let you come close to this place. You broke it with your own hands.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_fish: I'll try that patch of water, %1$s. We can all feel when the float moves.
Pass me the rod, %1$s. I focus better with you nearby.
Got one, %1$s! This catch belongs to both of us.
Look, %1$s! Everyone was holding their breath for that float.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.bond_mini: I'll open that block, %1$s. Its echo is quite clear.
There is ore ahead, %1$s. Watch the path while I work.
There, %1$s. That strike rang through all of us.
Found it, %1$s. We can put this to good use.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_fishi: I'll hold this line, %1$s. Once it bites, it does not escape.
Leave the bank to me, %1$s. Rest for a moment.
Clean pull, %1$s. One more piece for our supplies.
Caught it, %1$s. The little thing put up a decent fight.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.bond_minin: Half a step back, %1$s. I'll handle this vein.
Watch closely, %1$s. A few clean strikes will do it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_fish: Let's see who's more patient, me or the fish, %1$s.
Gimme the rod, %1$s. This fish ain't gonna beat me.
Ha, I won! Look at what I've caught, %1$s.
Woah! Careful, %1$s! It almost slipped away.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.bond_mini: Did you heard that, %1$s? It came from behind that wall.
Hmmm... Let's check behind that block wall, %1$s. There might be something good behind it.
Nailed it! I knew there was something worth, %1$s!
Found something, %1$s. See? I told you I heard something.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_fi: I'll read this water, %1$s. The school just passed below us.
Let me take the line, %1$s. The current knows where it should land.
I caught the current at the right moment, %1$s. This is yours.
Catch, %1$s! It thought it had hidden well.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.bond_mi: That ore vibrates differently from the stone, %1$s. I'll take it.
There is something in that crack, %1$s. It sounds close.
Found it, %1$s. Even the water above us trembled a little.
Hold this, %1$s. Stone cannot hide as well as fish.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_fi: I'll hold the line, %1$s. I can smell when a fish comes close.
Give me the rod, %1$s. Nothing at this bank escapes my ears.
Caught it, %1$s. Slippery, but not quick enough.
Take it, %1$s. It could not be fresher.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.bond_mi: Step aside, %1$s. Flying chips could hit you.
I smell metal, %1$s. It is behind this face.
That was it, %1$s. The metal scent came from here.
Take it, %1$s. The edge is sharp, so mind your hands.
menu.changed_synergy.social.negotiation_: Explain why you want your old form back
Help them understand how this feels to you
Works best if you started the fight
Give them a reason to let you go
Make it clear that this was not your choice
menu.changed_synergy.social.social_negot: Ask your assimilator to draw its latex back
Used your help to complete their body
menu.changed_synergy.negotiation.info.hi: Answer their motive and temperament. Empty pressure will not get far.
menu.changed_synergy.negotiation.info.sp: You helped them gain a complete body, and they remember it.
menu.changed_synergy.negotiation.info.re: Repeating the same argument makes it less effective.
menu.changed_synergy.negotiation.info.si: Each approach works once. Pick the wrong order and that chance is gone.
menu.changed_synergy.negotiation.option_: You have already used this argument
They wanted to keep you. Explain that companionship cannot be chosen for you.
They do not want to lose their host. Offer terms, or explain what being held inside feels like.
You hurt them first. A real apology will work better than more pressure.
They saw you as a threat to their group. Explain yourself, then own the part you crossed.
They believe you threatened their supplies. Admit the trespass or offer to make it right.
You helped complete their body. Remind them of that kindness without turning it into a demand.
message.changed_synergy.negotiation.avai: %1$s is willing to hear you out. Right-click them and choose negotiation on the social wheel.
message.changed_synergy.negotiation.abso: %1$s seems willing to hear you out. You can begin from the ability or relationship wheel.
message.changed_synergy.negotiation.sour: The latex creature surrounding you cannot answer right now.
%1$s is still surrounding you. You can try speaking to them now.
That creature is gone, so this negotiation is over.
message.changed_synergy.negotiation.no_r: There is not enough room to separate safely. Find a clearer spot and try again.
message.changed_synergy.negotiation.airb: [%1$s] I won't release you just yet.
message.changed_synergy.negotiation.host: [%1$s] There are hostile creatures nearby. I won't separate until we're somewhere safer.
message.changed_synergy.suit.airborne_re: They won't release you just yet.
message.changed_synergy.negotiation.cool: They do not want to talk right now. Try again in %1$s seconds.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.voluntary: Are you sure? Choose this again, and I'll bring you into our shared sense.
You're the one stepping closer this time. Confirm once more, and we'll welcome you in.
Welcome, partner. We can feel you here with us now.
Easy now. Find your balance. We're right here.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.voluntary_: Think it through. Choose this again, and we become partners.
This is not a joke. Confirm once more, and I'll do it.
Steady, partner. We saved you a place.
Done. We move side by side from here.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.voluntary: Oh, so you want to bond with me? I'm flattered, but are you truly sure?
A bond? I mean, sure! Just confirm once more, I take no returns!
Okay, partner. The bond is now complete. Tell me how it feels, don't rush it.
And, done! How does it feel?
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.volunta: Certain? Choose it again, and I'll bring you along with me.
One more confirmation. Then we take the next step together.
Welcome, partner. Take it slowly. I'm staying close.
All done. Water or shore, keep close to me.
dialogue.changed_synergy.organic.volunta: Are you sure you want this change? Confirm once more.
I will not make this choice for you. Select it again, and I will begin.
Breathe steadily, partner. Give your new body a moment.
It's done. Move when you're ready. I'll keep watch.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.negotiati: You want us to draw the latex back? All right. We're listening.
Uncomfortable in there? Easy now. Tell us what you need.
You helped me complete this body... and now you want out? I'm listening.
Mm. Your reasons reached us. Tell me a little more.
I can feel how uneasy you are. I'll think about this properly.
A trade? That may be worth discussing.
You mean it. Stop pushing for a moment and let me think.
That missed the point. Try another way.
Come closer and hold still. We will steady you, then draw the latex back slowly.
All right. I will hold you before I let you out, so you can stand when we separate.
Come here. I will support you. We will still know each other when we separate.
Hold still. I will steady you, then separate us one by one.
All right. I'll draw the latex back and return the choice to you.
All right, come out. Next time, speak before it gets this far.
You helped me gain a complete body. I can return your freedom. We are friends now.
Then we split. I return to my old shape, and you remain a white latex wolf. Until next time.
dialogue.changed_synergy.dark.negotiatio: You want me to undo the assimilation? Fine. Make your case.
You want out? Finish your argument, then I'll decide.
You had a hand in this complete body. You want to leave? Fine, let's talk.
I understand how you feel. I am not fully convinced yet.
Apology accepted. Now tell me the rest.
Interesting offer. Put a little more behind it.
Strong words. Now show me there is sense behind them.
No. That will not convince me.
We have an agreement. Stand firm. I will hold you and pull the latex back.
Deal. Hold still. I am letting you out in one piece.
The matter is settled. Come here. I will catch you before we separate.
All right. We separate now. Come closer, and both of us will land whole.
Fine. The latex comes back to me. You are free, but I will remember this.
Deal. You can come out. Speak sooner next time.
You helped me stand on my own, so I will let you go. We are square, friend.
Fine. We each return to our former shape. I will remember today.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.negotiati: So, you want to be back as human? Why would you want that?
Oh, I can feel you trying to get out. Very well, tell me, ¿why would I let you out?
I am now complete thanks to you, so we can talk about it. Go on.
Oh wow, I didn't knew it felt like that for you. I'm truly sorry.
Good. An apology is a good start for what you did. It's better than pretending nothing happened.
Ohh, a bargain? Sure! Tell me more about it.
Alright, I've heard you. You really won't budge at all, huh?
Hmmm... Nah, I'm not up for that. Got something else for me?
Alright, we've got a deal then. I'll remove the latex from your body now. Don't move.
Okay, that's a nice deal. I'll let you out slowly. Get back into your feet, slowly. Don't fall now, ok?
Okay, let's separate now. Just don't forget about me. Keep in mind we were as one for a moment there.
Let's split then. Hold on tight, this will only take a moment.
Alright, I've heard you. Let me remove the latex now. I'll let you choose next time.
Alright, alright. Take a deep breath of fresh air. Next time, I'll ask before absorbing you. Promise!
You were very kind to help me complete my body, so I will give your body back. Now we know each other even more.
Understood. I'll let you become a whie latex wolf again, and I'll be myself again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.aquatic.negotia: Want this change stripped away? Talk. I'm listening.
You want out of me? Fine. Say what you mean.
Without you, I would not have this complete body. You want out? Then let's talk.
I understand the reason. Keep going.
So that is what this feels like to you. Fine, that matters.
An apology is enough to start. I was not planning to chase this forever.
You want a trade? Fine. Let me hear the offer.
I know you did not want this. Stop shouting and keep talking.
Come closer. I will support you while I draw the latex back.
All right. I will hold you before I let go. Find your footing when you come out.
Come here. I will catch you so both of us are steady when we separate.
Stay steady. I will hold you while I separate the two bodies.
Fine. I'll take the latex back. Get your balance.
All right. I will let you out. We are even.
You helped me gain a complete body, so I will not take advantage. Come out, friend.
Fine. We both return to our old shapes. That settles it.
dialogue.changed_synergy.role.comfort_bo: Quiet... I just found a calm spot.
dialogue.changed_synergy.negotiation.com: You do not want to stay? All right. Talk to me.
I understand that you want the choice. Keep going.
I did not realize wearing my latex made you this uneasy.
You do not owe me an apology for wanting your own form back.
You still want to know me, just not like this? We can work with that.
I heard your no. I cannot pretend otherwise.
Telling me to let go is not enough. Tell me what truly bothers you.
Let's stop here. I need time to think, so come back later.
dialogue.changed_synergy.negotiation.hos: You want to come out of my body? Easy. Tell me why.
You need your own body and space. I understand that.
I did not know being held inside felt this bad to you.
An apology will not settle this. Tell me what happens after I release you.
You will stay close, but not as my host? That is worth discussing.
Stop struggling for a moment. I can hear you. Finish your demand.
You want out now, but I still have no reason to let my host go.
Not yet. Give me a little time, then we can talk again.
dialogue.changed_synergy.negotiation.sel: You hurt me, and now you want me to stop? Go on.
I know you panicked. That does not erase who struck first.
I can see that you are hurting. I was too.
All right. I accept that apology. Give me a moment.
Making amends helps, but I need to know you will not attack again.
Do not push me. The harder you press, the less safe release feels.
No. You are still making excuses for the attack.
I still don't trust you. Keep your distance and try again later.
dialogue.changed_synergy.negotiation.fac: You threatened more than me. Make your case.
If it was a mistake, I will carry your explanation to my kin.
I know you were afraid. You were not the only one under threat.
I heard the apology. The others still deserve an answer.
You want to repay the group? Be specific, then I will consider it.
Orders will not help. Show me you will leave my kin alone.
You are defending yourself without giving us a reason to trust you.
I won't risk my kin for this. Wait until everyone has calmed down.
dialogue.changed_synergy.negotiation.cac: You handled our supplies. Now you want to talk? I am listening.
Not knowing the rule did not undo the trespass, but I heard you.
I understand that you needed supplies. Everyone here worked for them.
That sounds like an apology. Ask before you search our cache again.
You will replace what you took? Keep that promise and I will release you.
The more you rush me, the less I believe you respect this outpost.
You will not even admit what you touched. I cannot trust that.
What happened at the outpost still matters. Stop pushing and come back later.
dialogue.changed_synergy.negotiation.spe: You helped complete this body. You want out? Let us talk.
Helping me did not mean you had to stay forever. I understand.
I was so excited to be whole that I forgot to ask what you wanted.
Perhaps I should apologize. I was too busy learning this new body.
We stay friends after we separate? I have little reason to refuse.
I know you mean it. Easy now. I will let you out.
Do not turn your help into a debt. Talk to me, and I will listen.
I'm not ready to separate yet. Let me get used to this a little longer.
dialogue.changed_synergy.negotiation.whi: You were already transfurred. I just followed my instincts and fused us together. If you want us apart, say so.
This centaur body fits well after taking you in. If you want your human body back, we can talk.
dialogue.changed_synergy.negotiation.dar: We share this two-headed body now. You want me to step out? I am listening.
dialogue.changed_synergy.negotiation.com: Come closer and hold still. I will steady you, then draw the latex covering your body back into me.
All right. I will steady you, then release you whole from inside my body.
Come closer. I will support you so both of us are steady when we separate.
Hold still. I will steady you before separating you from this body.
The latex is back with me. There. You are yourself again.
We are separate. Take it slowly and find your balance.
There. We each have our own body now. I will remember what happened.
There. I'm back in my own body, and you're steady in your old form again.
There. I have stepped out of the centaur body, and you are human again. We can call each other friends from now on.
We are separate. I am myself again, and you are back in your human body. We can call each other friends now.
dialogue.changed_synergy.white.white_kni: Wait. That new form of yours might fit with me perfectly... Want to try?
Hold on. Now I need to know what we would become together.
You look like the missing half of an idea. Let me try something.
So this is what it feels like. We fit better than I expected.
It worked. Give me a moment to get used to moving together.
Ha, I knew it. Even our steps line up.
dialogue.changed_synergy.light.white_kni: Wait. That form of yours may fit mine! Let's become one!
Hey, hold on! I really want to know how strong the two of use can be together.
You look like the right fit... Let's fuse together!
Wow... So this is how it feels. It feels better than I expected!
It... worked! Hey, slow down a bit, I want to get used to our body.
I knew it would be a great fit. Our stride lines up perfectly!
menu.changed_synergy.social.negotiation_: Offer one of their favorite foods to soften their stance
Offer a cooked fish to soften this feline creature's stance
Wanted to know how fusion felt
Wanted your help completing their body
They value the strength of your shared body. Offer cooperation, but remind them that the body belongs to you too.
They only wanted to know what fusion feels like. Tell them they cannot satisfy that curiosity with your body.
They treated fusion like a game. Start by making it clear that you did not find it fun.
They do not want to lose their complete body. Remind them that you helped complete it, but never gave them your own body.
message.changed_synergy.negotiation.no_b: You do not have any food this creature particularly likes.
dialogue.changed_synergy.fusion.fusion_s: Come closer. Together we will be stronger than individually.
I was correct. This shared body feels powerful, and I can meet every move you make.
dialogue.changed_synergy.fusion.fusion_c: Wait. I have to know what it feels like to fuse together.
So this is what it feels like. I can feel every move you make.
dialogue.changed_synergy.fusion.fusion_p: Let's try something new. We can share the same body for some time.
It worked. Now we won't walk alone.
dialogue.changed_synergy.fusion.fusion_c: Don't run. I just need your help to complete my body.
Whole, at last. So this is what being complete feels like.
dialogue.changed_synergy.negotiation.com: Food as persuasion? All right. At least you still want to stay and talk.
dialogue.changed_synergy.negotiation.hos: That smells good. Fine, I will stop clinging to the idea of keeping you. Keep talking.
dialogue.changed_synergy.negotiation.sel: Is this an apology? I will take it, but we still need to settle that attack.
dialogue.changed_synergy.negotiation.fac: I will take it, but the rest of my group still deserves an answer.
dialogue.changed_synergy.negotiation.cac: Using your own food to make amends beats rummaging through my barrel again. Go on.
dialogue.changed_synergy.negotiation.spe: You already helped me once, and you are offering this too? All right. I am listening.
dialogue.changed_synergy.negotiation.fus: We're clearly stronger together... You want us apart? Convince me.
I know you want control of your own body. The strength we have together is real too.
I did not realize sharing this body made you so uncomfortable.
I admit it. I made the choice for both of us.
You will still fight beside me after we separate? That is worth considering.
All right. I know you mean it. Let me think.
Trying to bargain with an orange? Fine... I'll hear you out a little longer.
Asking me to let go is not enough. Tell me why we must separate.
This body suits me. Let me keep it a little longer, then we can talk again.
I only wanted to know what becoming one felt like. Now I do... Do you want to separate?
Curiosity doesn't give me the right to decide for you... Yeah, I understand that.
I was caught up in the new feeling and never noticed how uneasy you were...
I let my curiosity get the better of me and never asked. That was wrong...
You will let me ask properly next time? Then we can separate now.
All right, I hear you... You really don't want this to continue.
That scent is worth investigating too. Fine, I will listen to you first.
Don't just rush me. Tell me what you most want to get away from.
I still don't understand this feeling... Give me time to think, then ask again.
I only wanted to try a bigger game, and we actually fused... Do you want to separate?
You did not enjoy any of this. Fine. My fun is not the only thing that matters.
You were tense the whole time, and I was too busy enjoying myself... I went too far.
All right, I am sorry. Next time I will ask before I play.
You will still play with me after we separate? That is a good offer.
I get it. You're not sulking. I'll think about it properly...
You brought food too? You know exactly what gets my attention.
A stern look won't convince me. Try saying it another way.
I'm not done playing yet... Let me stay like this a while longer. We can talk later.
With you, I finally have a complete body. You want me to let go already? Talk to me.
Helping me become whole did not mean you agreed to stay forever. That is fair.
I cared so much about being whole that I nearly forgot you had a body of your own.
I should be the one apologizing. I was too relieved to be whole to ask what you wanted.
You would still help me after we separate? Then I have no reason to hold you here.
Do not press too hard. I know you want out, but I need a moment too.
You are even willing to give me this? Then I should show some good faith too.
Hey, I only borrowed your body for a bit... Do you really have to act like I owe you a debt?
I only just got a complete body... Give me some time before you ask again.

hint.changed_synergy.pat.title: A gentler greeting
hint.changed_synergy.pat.message: Look at a latex creature and hold %s to pet it. This calms them down and raises their affection.
hint.changed_synergy.social.title: Social interaction
hint.changed_synergy.social.message: After forming a relationship, use %s with an empty hand to open its social wheel.
hint.changed_synergy.orange_gift.title: Offer an orange
hint.changed_synergy.orange_gift.message: Hold an orange and use %s on a latex creature to give it the fruit. It may come in handy when one is chasing you.
takeover.changed_synergy.title: Body Control
takeover.changed_synergy.borrow: Let me take over for a moment
takeover.changed_synergy.borrow_hint: Ask them to hand movement back for a little while
takeover.changed_synergy.confirm_warning: Click again to force your way out.
dialogue.changed_synergy.takeover.takeov: So, want to get out? Then pust a bit harder.
You want to be out of me, I see. Ok, show me what you've got.
Still trying to slip out? No more testing then, put some actual effort to it!
You want to be free of this timeout? Prove me you can actually break free.
takeover.changed_synergy.warning: You have one escape attempt. If it fails, you'll lose consciousness and wake somewhere safe.
takeover.changed_synergy.controlled: Your carrier is controlling the body
takeover.changed_synergy.mechanical: Manual control locked. Automatic control engaged.
advancement.changed_synergy.takeover_bre: Escape an ordinary body-control takeover and separate safely.
advancement.changed_synergy.wrapped_slee: Sleep through the night while wrapped by a bonded creature or an absorber.
config.changed_synergy.option.exoskeleto: Show the hypnosis visual and status log on this client while wearing an exoskeleton.
End an exoskeleton takeover with unconsciousness and removal. When disabled, control simply returns when the timer expires.
config.changed_synergy.option.takeover_e: Allow qualifying absorption and forced exoskeleton encounters to temporarily take control of the player. When disabled, hostile absorptions use the attacked-and-retaliated negotiation instead.
config.changed_synergy.option.takeover_p: Allow a latex creature to take control after the player deliberately provokes its faction.
config.changed_synergy.option.takeover_c: Allow competitive or show-off latex creatures to take control after absorption.
config.changed_synergy.option.takeover_e: Allow an exoskeleton to take control of a Benign Wolf or Orca player when its takeover conditions are met.
config.changed_synergy.option.takeover_b: Allow players in ordinary takeovers to request a short period of movement control.
config.changed_synergy.option.takeover_e: Allow one confirmed escape attempt during an ordinary takeover. This never applies to forced exoskeleton control.
config.changed_synergy.option.takeover_o: After a non-hostile ordinary takeover ends in sleep, provide three oranges at most once every 20 minutes.
config.changed_synergy.option.takeover_s: Duration in seconds for a non-punitive ordinary takeover.
config.changed_synergy.option.takeover_p: Duration in seconds for a punitive ordinary takeover.
config.changed_synergy.option.takeover_e: Seconds before forced exoskeleton control reaches its configured ending.
dialogue.changed_synergy.takeover.takeov: HA! You tried, and you failed. Now you're staying with me for a while.
Comfortable? That's good to hear. I want everyone to see who I am carrying.
Settle in. I'll make sure this little win of minne be comfortable for you.
Enough! You will stay here until you calm down!
You will stay in here as punishment for whay you did. This is just temporary, so don't try anything clever.
STOP! You will remain contained until you stop swinging at everyone.
Still comfortable? You sure are enjoying the ride. That's good to hear.
Let me show you around. No need to rush, just relax and enjoy the view.
Now you're safe and warm in there. Make yourself comfortable and enjoy the ride... while it lasts.
Stay calm and wait for this to be over. Don't try anything funny.
You won't be getting out until things settle down. Consider this a temporary time-out.
We haven't hurt you, so you don't have to fight us. You brought this to yourself, so I'm not letting you out yet.
%s, is that a passenger what you got there?
Can it hear us in there?
Hey, %s. Take care of the human you've got in there.
Alright, I'll let you steer my body for a while.
Go ahead. I'll let you out a bit longer this time.
I'll trust you with the body for a while. Don't make me regret it.
Okay. You'll get one short run. No crazy stuff.
Fine... But only for a moment, got it?
I'll let you move for a while. Do not cause any more trouble.
Not just yet. Let me settle us a bit longer.
Wait a little longer. I'll let you try in a sec, I promise.
Stop. First, settle down, then I'll let you try.
Not yet. I'll keep control for now, so get used to it.
Let me catch my breath before we swith again, okay?
Ask me in a moment. Let me think one sec...
But you just had a turn! Wait a bit longer.
Not again so soon. You'll have to wait a bit longer.
We're not hitting ground. Wait until we're down.
If we're not on solid ground, I'm not giving control to you.
I am not giving control to you if there are threats around.
Are you nuts? There's something dangerous close to us!
I'm currently busy with something. Ask again in a moment, okay?
Until I finish what I'm doing, I cannot switch safely. Hold on.
That ends the ride. I'll take it from here.
Alright, it's my turn again.
Your turn is over. I'm taking control back.
That's enough for now. Behave for the rest of the timeout.
Hey, take it easy! No need to violently tear your way out.
You really want to be out? Okay, show me what can you do.
Still combative I see. Make sure this only chance you have count!
Don't force it! This is your only attempt.
I see you're worn out. Get comfortable and take a rest; I'll let you out in a safe place.
So you finally got tired. The game is over then. Don't worry, you will wake up somewhere safe.
